scope: SettingsPage Skills & Context, ContextPreferences, MainWindow context injection; targeted validation/model-edit audit

fixed.issue: Workspace AGENTS and disabled skill choices leaked into unrelated workspaces.
fixed.change: skillOptions.workspaceSettings indexed by normalized canonical filesystem workspace; path dots remain literal JSON keys. Windows paths case-fold after native final-path resolution.

fixed.issue: Disabling a global skill wrote the workspace-disabled name list and suppressed workspace overrides.
fixed.change: Global toggle writes disabledGlobalSkills; workspace name override remains enabled. Explicit re-enable lifts both effective global/workspace suppressions.

fixed.issue: Failed saves left Respect AGENTS, custom-directory and optional-global-directory controls showing values that runtime did not use.
fixed.change: Checkbox rollback uses QSignalBlocker, while failed/stale/corrupt storage remains untouched. Successful directory toggles refresh the discovered list.

fixed.issue: Nested preset model lists bypassed validation.
fixed.verified: Seven malformed array/entry/override cases reject without replacing prior file.

fixed.issue: Editing missing-provider preset silently selected another provider.
fixed.verified: Unavailable saved choice is preserved; fixture detects any implicit provider substitution.

legacy_migration: Legacy unscoped respectAgentsMd/disabledSkills remain effective until an explicit workspace-specific edit. The edit copies their current effective values into the connected workspace record and removes the legacy unscoped fields atomically. Existing nondefault unscoped records cannot reveal their original workspace.
inspection_notes: MainWindow configures ContextLoader on every send from SettingsPage.preferences and active conversation workspace; disabled skills are filtered before slash invocation lookup.
Changing a context setting affects subsequent sends; previously sent instruction text is still in existing conversation/provider history.
Built-in/plugin skill directories are not yet assigned by ContextPreferences or host; plugin enablement UI explicitly discloses pending runtime integration.
Slash invocation currently parses first whitespace-delimited token; valid skill names containing spaces are not invocable by typed /name.
Settings reload uses fallback defaults while preserving invalid files; test evidence covers failed writes but does not establish process-concurrent CAS locking.
source_freeze: ContextPreferences.cpp/.h, buildSkills and skillOptions validation/default, test_settings_audit frozen for parent integrated build.
